fullModel.how: the live game model rebuilt on the cfb-research dump (md.json.gz, 2024-26, as scripts/cfb_game_backtest.mjs), eloRun swapped per variant, season-swap CV 2025 <-> 2026 (1,444 games), paired per game against the live 538 rule (K 20, home 70)

538 k25 h70.note: already in the live K grid

simShock2025.how: full-model ratings frozen before weeks 1, 5, 9 of 2025 (margin weights fit on 2025, in sample), weeks s-14 simulated, log loss of each FBS win count against fixed 4

conclusion.elo: Elo alone: a margin Elo (linear on the miss, K doubled early, regressed to the conference mean) beats the live 538 rule by a wide margin, tuned and held out; but inside the full model, where opponent-adjusted EPA already carries the margin signal, every margin-Elo variant is worse (t +1.6 to +3.1) and the 538 tweaks tie. Not shipped; the live rule and its K/home grid stay.
conclusion.sim: Shipped: simulate() team shock 8 x sqrt(min(1, games left / 12)) in place of a fixed 4.
conclusion.market: The close absorbs Elo: margin ~ close + Elo adds nothing held out (t +0.2 to +0.6); the log-loss blend puts 0 on the live Elo and 0.10 on the margin Elo (held out -0.0005, t -1.3).
